name: alp-desktop
description: ALP desktop shell for macOS: opens the user's installed alp dashboard in its own window (D32).

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/main.cjs && rm -rf dist/pages && cp -R src/pages dist/pages && cp ../../install.sh dist/install.sh
scripts.start: bun run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.e2e: bun run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/shell.spec.ts e2e/install.spec.ts e2e/owner.spec.ts e2e/browser.spec.ts e2e/desktop-feel.spec.ts
scripts.dist: bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
